answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains using zero-knowledge proofs. Each agent registers via a hardware enclave, staking capital into a bonded tree where an attacker faces exponential capital exhaustion: registering an entire orchard of clone bots superlinearly escalates bond requirements ($C \propto k^n$). An automated audit script, codenamed quill, records provenance up to a verification mesa.
